== Name

inline-whitespace-substitutions - preserve requested whitespace substitutions

== Description

[subs="quotes,attributes"]
S02 A``{sp}``B.

[subs="attributes,quotes"]
S03 A `{sp}` B.

[subs="quotes,attributes"]
S04 A `{sp}` B.

[subs="attributes,quotes"]
S05 A**{sp}**B.

[subs="quotes,attributes"]
S06 A**{sp}**B.

[subs="-attributes"]
S07 A``{sp}``B.

[subs="-quotes"]

[subs="none"]
